'''Dewgrub''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Ripplewing]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Gathers fresh morning dew every day and is considered the most eager of the 'morning Tatari' bunch."

Dewgrub is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Dewgrub is a small, rounded, caterpillar-like Tatari. It is various shades of blue, white, and purple. Dewgrub has six white legs, two white antennae, two small blue and purple wings, and only one large blue and purple eye visible.
Dewgrub also has what appears to be a small tail-like structure, which may be a nod toward real-world caterpillar defenses, like spines, urticating hairs, or the osmeterium of swallowtail caterpillars, though may also just be a stylistic choice. 

Glitter Dewgrub swaps shades of blue for shades of pale and sage green, and swaps purple and indigo for turquoise and teal. The eye, leg, and antennae colors remain unchanged.

== Evolution Trial ==
Dewgrub's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Ripplewing]] you need to complete the following task:

* Clear 10 stages with Dewgrub and [[Ashlarva]] together.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "How come [[Waveflutter]] and [[Charflutter]] look alike, but Dewgrub looks nothing like [[Ashlarva]]?"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Concealed beneath leaves, Dewgrub rises only when morning dew gathers. The droplets upon the body fade or condense according to mood."
